scope: Every claim in evidence/claims.json was classified. Official Red Hat/Ansible quotes are required where those vendors can actually establish the proposition; repository, runtime and third-party claims are explicitly not converted into vendor claims.

verdict_legend.VERIFIED: The cited official excerpt directly establishes the vendor/product proposition.
verdict_legend.VERIFIED_WITH_BOUNDARY: The official excerpt establishes only the documented part; repository/runtime evidence establishes the rest.
verdict_legend.CORRECTED: The prior cheatsheet wording conflicted with current official product guidance and is corrected in this branch.
verdict_legend.OUT_OF_SCOPE: The claim is not an Ansible/Red Hat documentation proposition; use the named repository/runtime or third-party evidence instead.
